messages_author.name: messages_author
messages_author.value: ("messages"."author_type" = 'person' and "messages"."author_agent_id" is null) or ("messages"."author_type" = 'agent' and "messages"."author_user_id" is null)

notifications_snoozed.name: notifications_snoozed
notifications_snoozed.where: "notifications"."snoozed_until" is not null and "notifications"."done_at" is null

machine_tasks_live_session.name: machine_tasks_live_session
machine_tasks_live_session.where: "machine_tasks"."mission_id" is not null and "machine_tasks"."session_id" is not null and "machine_tasks"."ended_at" is null
